title: Scheme morphism properties descend through an fppf refinement
statement: Let $X\xrightarrow{a}Y\xrightarrow{b}Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Fix $P$ to be one of flatness [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], or locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Suppose $b\circ a$ has $P$. Assume there is a set-indexed fppf covering $\{q_i:Y_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] and morphisms $s_i:Y_i\to X$ such that $a\circ s_i=q_i$ for all $i$. Then $b$ has $P$, separately for each of the three choices. No flatness, finiteness, separation, or quasi-compactness assumption is made on $a$.

proof.text: Fix affine opens $W=\operatorname{Spec}C\subseteq Z$ and $V=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq Y$ with $b(V)\subseteq W$. Apply [lem-sfb-fppf-lifts-finite-affine-charts] to $a$ and $V$. Write its finite ring towers as $C\to B\to A_j\to D_j$, and put $A=\prod_jA_j$ and $D=\prod_jD_j$. All maps are the coordinate maps induced by the displayed factorizations; in particular $C\to B\to A\to D$ is a ring tower. The lemma gives $B\to D$ faithfully flat and finitely presented, independently of the chosen property $P$.

source.place: Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, affine preparation and three-case proof.

proof.text: Each $U_j=\operatorname{Spec}A_j$ lies in $(b\circ a)^{-1}(W)$. If $P$ is flatness, [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-affine-criterion] makes every $A_j$ flat over $C$, and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-product-flat-modules] makes $A$ flat over $C$. If $P$ is local finite type, [lem-weil-pbc-lft-affine-pairs] makes each $A_j$ finite type over $C$. Their finite product is finite type: take the coordinate idempotents $e_j$ and the elements supported in coordinate $j$ from a finite generating set of $A_j$; every tuple is the sum of its coordinate expressions. If $P$ is local finite presentation, [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation] makes every $C\to A_j$ finitely presented. Apply [lem-trf-finite-affine-composite-presentation] with its $S=X=V=W=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $f=\mathrm{id}$, $U_j=T_j=\operatorname{Spec}A_j$, and $h_j$ the induced maps to $\operatorname{Spec}C$: their composites are locally finitely presented by their single affine presentations. It gives $C\to A$ finitely presented. The empty product is the zero algebra and satisfies all three assertions.

source.place: Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, affine preparation and three-case proof.

proof.text: In the flat case, let $u:N\hookrightarrow N_1$ be an injective map of $C$-modules and let $z\in N\otimes_C B$ map to zero in $N_1\otimes_C B$. Its image in $N\otimes_C A$ is zero, since tensoring $u$ with the flat $C$-module $A$ is injective. Therefore its image in $N\otimes_C D$ is zero. But the map $N\otimes_C B\to N\otimes_C D$ is injective: it is the map $M\to M\otimes_B D$ for $M=N\otimes_C B$, under $(n\otimes b)\otimes d\mapsto n\otimes bd$, so [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-universally-injective] applies to $B\to D$. Thus $z=0$. The definition [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] now proves $C\to B$ flat. This uses no flatness of $B\to A$ or $A\to D$.

source.place: Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, affine preparation and three-case proof.

proof.text: In the finite-type case, $B\to D$ is finitely presented and hence finite type: a finite presentation supplies finite algebra generators. Those same generators generate $D$ over $A$, because the map $B\to D$ factors through $A$. Since $A$ is finite type over $C$, the images of generators of $A/C$ together with generators of $D/A$ generate $D/C$. Apply [lem-a1-finite-type-fppf-source-algebra] to the tower $C\to B\to D$: $C\to D$ is finite type and $B\to D$ is faithfully flat and finitely presented. It follows that $C\to B$ is finite type.

source.place: Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, affine preparation and three-case proof.

proof.text: In the finite-presentation case, $C\to A$ is finitely presented, hence finite type. Its generators also generate $A$ over $B$, since $C\to A$ factors through $B$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-over-finite-type-algebra] to $B\to A\to D$: $B\to D$ is finitely presented and $B\to A$ is finite type, so $A\to D$ is finitely presented. Composition by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-base-change-composition](2) shows that $C\to D$ is finitely presented. Apply [lem-trf-finite-presentation-fppf-source-algebra] to $C\to B\to D$, using faithful flatness and finite presentation of $B\to D$, to obtain finite presentation of $C\to B$.

source.place: Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, affine preparation and three-case proof.

proof.text: The pair of affine opens $V\subseteq Y$, $W\subseteq Z$ was arbitrary. The flat case therefore gives flatness of $b$ by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-affine-criterion]; the finite-type case gives local finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-lft-affine-pairs]. In the finite-presentation case each point of $Y$ has an affine neighbourhood $V$ mapping into an affine neighbourhood $W$ of its image, and the preceding finite presentation of $C\to B$ is exactly the local presentation required by [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. This proves the three alternatives separately, including empty schemes.
